details:
I have a couple suggestions for the Reporting feature. These are created with safety in mind for as many people as possible.

1. Reporting people who are too young to be playing VRChat, according to current age restrictions; this is largely self explanatory, and designed to try and help keep kids who are too young to be playing VRC off of the platform due to age related rule violations. If enough of these types of reports are made to the account, I do not know how many is reasonable, the account owner and all active account users, this is in case people share accounts, have to meet with VRC moderation staff so that moderator staff can verify that the person is old enough to be playing; accounts that are found to have active users who are under the age minimum to be playing are then locked out of logging into the game until the youngest active user on the account is old enough to be playing. This can be revoked by contacting moderation staff and proving to them you are of age.

2. Reporting people who are too young to be in certain worlds/groups; mostly self explanatory, but this would be designed to keep minors out of 18+ groups/maps. Many maps and groups, i.e many drinking maps/groups, ERP maps/groups, and the like, are not listed as 18+ and expect users to know by default that that's the case, so being able to report minors who are in these groups/maps and have them be instantly booted from them will help keep minors away from any potential creeps and/or unsafe activities. If a user gets enough reports while in a group/map of being underage, age has to be specified by the reporter, they will be instantly banned from the map/group until they become of age. Group/map owners are allowed to manually reverse the auto ban, or can turn off the option to do so, or set a specific unban time limit.

I hope something exact/similar can be implemented to help keep people safe.
title: Update Suggestions to the Report a User Feature
